pages.text: Steel starts with $(item)coal coke$(). Crushed into $(item)coal coke dust$(), it is the only fuel the blast furnace burns, so the coke oven is the first machine of your steel line.

The oven bakes one input at a time and gives:$(li)$(item)Coal$() becomes $(item)coal coke$(), plus creosote and CO2.$(li)Any $(item)log that burns$() becomes $(item)charcoal$(), plus creosote and CO2.
The solid result drops out of the front door as an item. The two by-products are fluids that stay in the oven until you pump them out.
A single coke oven block already works on its own. Building several into a square makes one bigger oven that cooks faster. The next pages show the shape, then how to feed it and how to empty it.
